title: Senior Web Development Manager / Technical Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Ocean Multivision is a 360° branding and business transformation company that believes branding should not only be visible but also deliver measurable performance. The organization operates at the intersection of strategy, systems, and storytelling, helping businesses build structured, growth-driven ecosystems. Ocean Multivision focuses on aligning how a brand looks, communicates, and functions in real-world business environments. The company’s approach emphasizes scalability, conversion, and long-term business impact, making it an environment where technology and creativity work together to drive results.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Senior Web Development Manager / Technical Lead role is based in Noida. The role involves leading end-to-end web development initiatives, overseeing the design, development, and deployment of web applications and digital platforms. The individual will manage and mentor development teams, collaborate closely with design, marketing, and strategy stakeholders, and ensure technical solutions align with business goals and brand performance objectives. Responsibilities include defining technical architecture, setting coding standards, reviewing code quality, managing project timelines, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure solutions. The role also requires proactive problem-solving, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of web systems and processes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Front-End Development and Web Development, including modern frameworks and responsive design practices.
* Experience building and maintaining Web Applications, with a focus on performance, security, and scalability.
* Solid background in Software Development, including clean coding practices, version control, and debugging.
* Proven Project Management abilities to plan, prioritize, and deliver multiple initiatives on schedule.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and conducting architectural and code reviews.
* Familiarity with backend technologies, APIs, databases, and integration with third-party services.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in digital, branding, or agency environments is an advantage.

title: Tech Intern
description:
Job Title: Tech Intern (Software Engineering / Development)

Company: Multiplier AI Limited

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Job Type: Full-Time | Work from Office

Duration: 3 to 6 Months (Internship)

Total Experience Required: 0–1 Year (Freshers or candidates with prior tech internship/project experience preferred)

Stipend: ₹15,000 - ₹20,000 Monthly (Fixed Stipend + Performance Bonus)

Qualification: Pursuing or completed B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, IT, or related technical disciplines

About the Role

Multiplier AI Limited is looking for an energetic, curious, and target-driven Tech Intern to join our Engineering & Product team in Noida.

In this role, you will assist in developing, testing, maintaining, and enhancing software applications across our technology stack. You will work closely with senior developers, technical leads, and product managers to write clean code, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to production-grade software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

This position is strictly focused on hands-on software development, coding, bug fixing, and technical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Software Development & Coding

- Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well-documented code under the supervision of senior engineers.

- Assist in developing front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, or database scripts based on product requirements.

- Work with modern frameworks, libraries, and tools used within the company's tech stack.

- Participating in code reviews to receive constructive feedback and continuously improve coding standards.

2. Bug Fixing & Technical Support

- Identify, debug, and resolve software bugs, performance bottlenecks, and operational issues.

- Assist in writing unit test cases and integration tests to ensure system reliability and code quality.

- Participate in daily stand-ups, technical discussions, and sprint planning sessions with the engineering team.

- Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, or libraries to solve specific technical problems.

3. Documentation & Version Control

- Maintain and update technical documentation, API specifications, and architecture notes.

- Utilize version control systems (Git/GitHub/GitLab) for code deployment, branching, and collaboration.

- Track tasks, bugs, and project progress using project management tools (Jira, Trello, or similar).

4. System Architecture & Product Integration

- Assist in integrating third-party APIs, web services, and database modules.

- Collaborate with product design and UI/UX teams to build responsive and user-friendly web/mobile interfaces.

- Support deployment pipelines and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

Candidate Requirements

Mandatory

- Strong passion for software engineering, coding, and technology problem-solving.

- Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, or C#).

- Basic understanding of web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React/Node.js) or database management (SQL / MongoDB).

- Familiarity with Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.

- Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control.

- Excellent logical reasoning, analytical, and communication skills.

- Proactive attitude, quick learning ability, and willingness to adapt in a fast-paced environment.

- Available for full-time, in-office work at our Noida office.

Preferred

- Prior internship experience, open-source contributions, or personal project portfolio in software development.

- Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Cloud basics (AWS/GCP/Azure), or Docker containers.

- Degree (completed or pursuing) in B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Compensation & Growth

- Monthly Stipend: ₹15,000 - ₹20,000 per month (Fixed Stipend + Performance-Linked Bonus)

- PPO Opportunity: Performance-based Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) for full-time employment upon successful completion of the internship.

**Technical Lead**
with 10+ years of experience in software engineering and architecture to lead the development of a
**web portal and mobile application**
for pension and benefits administration.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with the development team, participates actively in solution design, gathers requirements, and drives the technical execution from concept to delivery.

* Experience guiding teams building UI using React.js, Next.js, component libraries, and responsive UI principles.

* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of cloud-native architecture and deployment practices (Azure preferred).
* Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes is a plus.

**Testing & Quality**

* Experience with automated testing frameworks
* Knowledge of performance testing, accessibility standards, and monitoring/observability.

**Leadership & Management Skills**

* Proven experience leading engineering teams of 10–15 members.
* Strong ability to break down requirements, plan sprints, and manage delivery timelines.
* Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and escalation management skills.
* Experience building SaaS-based products or working in a startup-like environment is mandatory.

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Product Modernization - ACC+AJO Migration - Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We seek Senior Consultants and Architects with deep, hands-on expertise in Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC), Adobe Campaign Standard (ACS), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) to help enterprise customers modernize campaign and customer-journey programs. The role leads discovery, current-state assessment, target-state architecture, implementation, integration, testing, coexistence, cutover, and enablement. You will understand how customers use ACC or ACS today, identify use cases suited to AJO, and redesign them for AEP and AJO. Some functionality must be rebuilt, redesigned, retained, or handled through an integration or alternative solution. Candidates must explain product boundaries, assess feature and use-case fit, surface gaps early, and set realistic customer expectations. In AJO, a migrated use case lands on AJO Journeys (profile-centric, event-driven orchestration on AEP Real-Time Customer Profile) or AJO Orchestrated Campaigns (campaign-centric, batch, multi-step workflows on the AEP relational data store). Candidates must design and build on both, and recommend the right path per use case.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
- Assess and plan
- Lead discovery workshops with marketing, campaign operations, data, architecture, security, mobile, and IT stakeholders.
- Inventory the Campaign estate: use cases (batch, scheduled, transactional, event-triggered, real-time); assets (campaigns, workflows, audiences, deliveries, templates, content blocks, personalization, typologies, suppression rules, reporting); data (schemas and extensions, custom resources, relational data, targeting dimensions, identifiers, consent, opt-out, quarantine, bounce, engagement history); and infrastructure (on-premises or Managed Services hosting, network access, firewalls, file transfer, decommissioning needs).
- Reverse-engineer custom logic and document the business rules: technical and marketing workflows (query, enrichment, split, deduplication, reconciliation, update data, JavaScript code activities), custom JavaScript, JSSP, SOAP/JS API calls, SQL functions, stored procedures, custom relational structures, typology rules, input forms, web applications, landing pages, subscriptions, Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, offer logic, external accounts, APIs, middleware, and enterprise integrations.
- Map each use case and dependency to an AJO/AEP target pattern and classify it as reuse, redesign, rebuild, integrate, defer, or retain elsewhere. For custom logic, decide whether to re-express it in AEP/AJO (data model, Query Service, custom actions, external services), redesign or rebuild it separately, or retain it in Campaign.
- Choose the execution path per use case based on the target customer experience, not the shape of the source Campaign workflow. Use AJO Journeys when each profile should progress individually based on behaviour, events, or elapsed time, including many scheduled and recurring Campaign workflows rebuilt as Read Audience or business-event journeys. Use Orchestrated Campaigns for relational or multi-entity data, complex audience construction and enrichment, exact pre-send counts, and multi-level sending. Use action campaigns for simple scheduled or API-triggered sends. Document the rationale, combined patterns, and license prerequisites (e.g., the Journey Optimizer Campaigns package).
- Surface product-fit gaps and operational impacts before committing to scope or feature-parity claims. Advise when Campaign coexistence or another path fits better: Campaign v8 for ACC customers, or the ACS-to-Campaign v8 transition for ACS customers.
- Develop phased roadmaps, effort estimates, dependency plans, risks, and customer decision points.
- Architect and implement
- Design the AEP foundation: XDM schemas and field groups (profile, event, lookup); identity namespaces, identity resolution, profile enablement, and data relationships; datasets, sources, destinations, batch and streaming ingestion, and event design; data quality and governance; audience qualification and segmentation; and Query Service or other processing for transformation, aggregation, and enrichment.
- Replace common Campaign data patterns with AEP capabilities: Federated Audience Composition on Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, or other warehouses (closest to ACC Federated Data Access); computed attributes for profile-level aggregates; Data Distiller for scheduled SQL transformations; merge policies; and profile and segmentation guardrails.
- Design customer experiences and build AJO journeys and campaigns across batch and event-driven engagement: event- and segment-triggered orchestration, conditions, actions, custom actions, message content, personalization, and decisioning.
- Apply journey and campaign governance and optimization: business rules, frequency capping, quiet hours, journey priority and arbitration, conflict management, wave sending, content experimentation, and decisioning policies and rankings.
- Define security, access, permissions, governance, and operational controls.
- Build channels, integrations, and extensibility
- Configure AJO channels end to end: email, mobile and web push, in-app, web, code-based experiences, content cards, inbox, live activities, SMS/MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, and direct mail. Cover channel configurations, subdomains, API credentials, feedback webhooks, mobile app and SDK dependencies, channel-specific data and consent requirements, and template approval rules (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta).
- Connect messaging providers: native SMS providers (Sinch, Twilio, Infobip); bring-your-own-provider (BYOP) setups with provider payloads, inbound keyword handling, delivery receipts, and opt-in/opt-out webhooks and flows; and Channel Builder custom channels for non-native platforms or customer-owned gateways (e.g., regional or industry-specific providers), covering endpoint, authentication, throttling, payload structure, and monitoring.
- Design and build integrations using supported APIs, source connectors, file exchange, middleware, or Adobe solution integrations, including custom actions that call external systems from journeys (CRM, loyalty, order, recommendation, call-center, notification services) with request/response schemas, authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, mTLS), capping, throttling, retries, and error handling.
- Implement event and API-triggered patterns: unitary and business events, API-triggered and transactional campaigns, Interactive Message Execution / Journey and Campaign APIs, and streaming ingestion via HTTP API.
- Design and build Journeys (profile-centric)
- Select and configure the journey entry pattern per use case: unitary-event journeys for behavioural and transactional signals; audience qualification journeys on streaming audiences for real-time lifecycle moments; Read Audience journeys, one-shot or recurring with incremental read, for scheduled and batch-initiated programs that previously ran as recurring Campaign workflows; and business-event journeys that release an audience when an operational event occurs (e.g., a price drop or flight delay). Configure identity namespaces, reentrance and wait periods, exit criteria, and time zones.
- Build multi-step journeys where each customer progresses at their own pace: Wait activities; the Optimize activity for conditions, path targeting, and path experiments; reaction events on opens and clicks with timeout paths; Update Profile; Content Decision for offers; external data sources and custom actions for real-time lookups and system writebacks; and Jump activities to split complex programs into reusable journeys.
- Use supplemental identifiers (e.g., order, booking, subscription, or policy IDs), where enabled, to run one journey instance per entity and personalize with its attributes. Decide when per-entity use cases fit journeys versus orchestrated campaign multi-level sending.
- Support phased migration and coexistence from the journey canvas, including Adobe Campaign v7/v8 and ACS actions that let AJO orchestrate while Campaign transactional messaging delivers, until channels and content move to native AJO.
- Design within journey guardrails (one active instance per profile per journey, one Read Audience per journey and concurrent-run limits, entrance and processing throughput per sandbox, Jump and supplemental identifier restrictions, reaction event placement, custom action capping, and versioning impact on live profiles). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Design and build Orchestrated Campaigns (relational)
- Design the data model with AEP relational (model-based) schemas, built manually or from a DDL or Excel upload: tables, primary and composite keys, version descriptors (e.g., lastmodified), ENUMs, data governance labels, identity fields mapped to identity namespaces, and links with correct cardinality (1-N, N-1, 1-1) to recipient and profile entities.
- Configure target dimensions, including the profile target dimension linking XDM profile and experience event data to relational data; decide what belongs in the profile store versus relational tables to avoid duplication.
- Set up Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion from supported sources (e.g., Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Databricks, Data Landing Zone): the \_change\_request\_type field for file-based loads, table logging for cloud warehouses, complete-record loads, deletion handling, and latency planning.
- Build multi-step canvases with targeting, flow control, and channel activities (Build, Read, and Save audience, Enrichment, Change dimension, Combine, Deduplication, Reconciliation, Split, Fork, AND-join, Wait, Alert), including multi-entity segmentation and multi-level sending (e.g., one message per booking, contract, subscription, account, or address linked to a profile) personalized with enriched relational attributes. Configure scheduling, recurring runs, and pre-send count validation.
- Design within orchestrated campaign guardrails (table count and schema size limits, daily change-volume limits, scalar-only audience attributes, uncached audience evaluation, permanent dataset table names, channel availability by license). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Migrate data, logic, and personalization
- Translate the ACC/ACS relational data model to AEP: map recipient, custom, and relational tables to XDM profile, experience event, and lookup schemas, or to relational schemas for orchestrated campaigns; define primary and secondary identities, relationships, cardinality, and denormalization trade-offs.

* Evaluate experimentation requirements and determine the technical feasibility of implementation.

* Partner with analytics teams to ensure experiments are measured correctly.

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
* Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
* Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
* Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
* Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
* Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
* Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
* Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
  

* Hands-on engineering: You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
* Customer empathy: You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
* Collaboration and communication: You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Enterprise architecture: You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
* Data expertise: You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
* AI fluency and continuous learning: You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
* Proactive problem solving: You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.

What You Need to Succeed
  
  

* 10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
* Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
* Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
* Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
* Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.

Why This Team
  
  
You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.
  
  
Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!
  
  
Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
Let’s Adobe together
  
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
  
  
AI Use Guidelines for Interviews
  
  
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  
At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

**What We Look For**

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Senior Angular Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
You will work on the parts of an application people feel rather than see: how fast it becomes usable, whether it stays smooth on a mid-range Android device, whether the component someone writes next month fits the system you left behind. We build with signals, zoneless change detection and SSR, and we care about the result on real hardware rather than a benchmark.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Build and maintain Angular applications for enterprise clients, from architecture through to production support
* Own component and state design in a signals-first, zoneless codebase
* Work with SSR and prerendering, and keep hydration correct rather than merely working
* Hold the performance budget: Core Web Vitals, bundle size and what actually renders on a mid-range device
* Review pull requests — including AI-generated ones, which pass the same bar as any other
* Write the tests that let the next person change your code with confidence

What we’re looking for
  
  

* Five or more years building production Angular, including at least one large application you owned
* Deep TypeScript, RxJS where it earns its place, and a real understanding of change detection
* Comfortable with accessibility as a requirement rather than an afterthought
* Able to explain a technical trade-off to a client without retreating into jargon

Nice to have
  
  
Not required. Apply if the section above fits.
  
  

* Angular 17+ with signals, SSR and deferrable views
* Nx or another monorepo at scale
* Design-system or component-library ownership

How to apply
  
  
Send your CV to hr@itlabz.in with “Senior Angular Engineer” in the subject line, or WhatsApp it to +91 95605 15123. Either reaches the same team, and we reply to every application.
  
  
Email your CV Send on WhatsApp

title: DE-NCLC-M365 Migration and Modernization Senior-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**DE NCLC Senior – Technology Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant with strong capabilities in SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex. The resource will be part of the Enterprise Content Management and Modern Workplace team, delivering solutions to clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for professionals with expertise in Microsoft 365 consulting, migration and modernization to join our AI Workforce Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to large transformation programs while supporting the growth of our Microsoft 365 service offerings.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work with client and project teams to understand business requirements, current-state environments and modernization objectives.
* Design and deliver SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions using SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP and PowerShell.
* Plan and execute Microsoft 365 migrations, including SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams workloads, with appropriate assessment, remediation, testing and cutover activities.
* Assess and modernize Nintex workflows and forms, including Nintex for SharePoint and Nintex Automation Cloud.
* Prepare technical designs, migration plans, mapping documents, test scripts, deployment guides and operational handover documentation.
* Troubleshoot migration, workflow, solution and integration issues, escalating risks and dependencies when required.
* Ensure deliverables comply with project standards, security requirements, governance processes and technical design principles.
* Support estimates, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts and technical discussions with stakeholders.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators and best practices for Microsoft 365 migration and modernization engagements.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 5-8 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Good knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, information architecture, permissions, content types, site designs and governance concepts.
* Experience in Microsoft 365 migrations covering SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, including discovery, assessment, remediation, migration execution, validation and cutover.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
* Self-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Good presentation and client-facing skills
* Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams
* Collaborative team player with a positive and constructive approach

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant Microsoft 365, SharePoint, migration or modernization experience.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise in SPFx and Microsoft 365 migration delivery.
* Practical experience with Nintex workflows and forms.
* Strong consulting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and translate complex requirements into manageable deliverables.
* Ability to operate independently with minimum supervision and support junior team members.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
* Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
* Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
* Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
* Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
* Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
* Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
* Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.

**What Success Looks Like**
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
  

* Hands-on engineering: You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
* Customer empathy: You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
* Collaboration and communication: You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Enterprise architecture: You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
* Data expertise: You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
* AI fluency and continuous learning: You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
* Proactive problem solving: You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* 10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
* Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
* Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
* Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
* Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.

**Why This Team**
You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.
  
  
**Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!**
Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
**Let’s Adobe together**
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
  
  
**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  
At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

title: Computer Scientist
description:
Adobe Express Imaging team is looking for an energetic, dynamic Web App engineer who can take it to the next level. The role is in the Imaging pillar in Adobe Express, responsible for delivering delightful experiences on mobile \& web. Overall, during your work experience in Adobe Express, you will touch on every aspect of native/web development, and you will be able to experiment in every other area, learn from those experiences, and take them to the next level.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Responsible for the design and architecture of new components/features. Developing and proposing new features and fixing bugs.
* Build and improve image editing capabilities, including rendering workflows, editing operations, and UI interactions related to image manipulation.
* Develop high\-performance, reliable, testable, well\-documented and maintainable code.
* Collaborate with architects, product management, and other engineering teams to build the technical vision and roadmap for the team.
* As a unified engineer, you will be responsible for development, testing, automation, and full delivery of the same feature.
* Leverage generative and agentic AI technologies to improve development efficiency, prototyping speed, and automation.
* Build workflows that use AI to accelerate feature development, testing, and debugging while maintaining strong engineering validation standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* B.Tech / M.Tech degree in Computer Science from a premier institute.
* Must have 4\-7 years of software design and development experience, preferably in a product development environment.
* Experience in front\-end web tech stack with strong hands\-on experience in JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience using generative AI or agentic development frameworks to improve engineering productivity and accelerate development workflows.
* Should have excellent computer science fundamentals and a good understanding of design and performance of algorithms. Familiarity with operating systems, computer architecture, and OS internals.
* Experience working on large codebases with complex architecture.
* Strong understanding of performance optimisation, memory management, and system resource constraints.
* Hands\-on experience building or contributing to image editing or graphics\-related applications is a preferred.
* Regular development experience with agentic development tools (cursor, claude etc.)


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Android and iOS app development
* Proficiency in C, C\+\+.
* Experience with Web Assembly(WASM), advanced JavaScript APIs or WebGL.
* Experience in the Graphics domain or with graphic libraries such as Skia.

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager - Applications Development - MEAN Stack
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Mercer Tech at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Gurugram. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

 As a
 **Lead Software Developer** 
 at Mercer, you will play a key role in shaping our future in the rapidly evolving field of, scalable Shared Services that incorporate AI capabilities. Collaboration is essential, as you will work within a team that follows Scaled Agile methodologies. We are seeking a self\-motivated and delivery\-focused individual with a strong technology background, where experience in AI integrations and prompt engineering will be advantageous, to help us grow our talent and drive innovation in this exciting sector.
   

  

**We will count on you to:**
* Ensure Shared Service requirements are gathered accurately, fully understood, and communicated clearly to all stakeholders, with transparency on impacts and dependencies.
* Design, develop, and support secure, scalable backend and frontend services using Phyton, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Implement authentication and security solutions leveraging JWT, SAML/OIDC, Okta integration, Microsoft EntraID and Passport / Passport\-SAML concepts.
* Build and maintain data persistence layers using Postgresql, MongoDB and Mongoose to deliver robust and reliable application functionality.
* Develop automated tests and support quality assurance practices using Jest, NestJS testing patterns, class\-validator, and class\-transformer. Including documentation, and usage guidance to ensure shared services are easy to adopt, maintain, and support.
* Integrate applications using Express, including body\-parser and cookie\-parser, and work effectively with NestJS guards, hooks, modules, and dependency injection.
* Use Git, npm ecosystem, and environment configuration management effectively to support local development, testing, and delivery.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code aligned to Agile user stories and established engineering standards, while leveraging AI development productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot and resolve development and integration issues, with a focus on performance, authentication, and service interoperability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, serving as a role model and supporting their growth within the team.
* Collaborate with peers to foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
* Champion Agile practices that support effective product delivery and strong team collaboration.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with product owners, solutions architects, analysts, and leadership to ensure alignment of technical solutions with business objectives.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to solve real\-world challenges and enhance our software solutions.
* Provide technical support to consumers of the Shared Services for existing issues and recommend enhancements to current solutions.


**What is in it for you?**
* Chance to work on enterprise\-grade shared services used by multiple teams (high visibility and impact).
* Exposure to AI integrations and prompt engineering (advantageous/valued experience).
* Work with modern engineering practices: cloud\-native architecture, CI/CD, DevOps quality gates, security\-first delivery.
* A culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, with scope to grow as a technical leader.


**What you need to have:**
 We are seeking candidates with a proven track record in developing multiple products/services, ideally those that incorporate AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess:
   

  

* Shared Services Mindset: Demonstrates a strong focus on building reusable components and services that support multiple teams, reduce duplication, and improve consistency across the platform.
* Strong Communication Skills: Ability to effectively interact with both technical and non\-technical colleagues in a cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Self\-Starter and Team Contributor: A proactive individual who takes initiative in their work, embraces a model of continuous learning to stay updated with industry trends and technologies, and actively contributes to team success by collaborating effectively and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
* Diverse Software Delivery Experience: A successful history of delivering software across a variety of languages, technologies, and platforms, with familiarity in AI frameworks and libraries being a plus.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile at Scale, Lean, and Continuous Delivery methodologies to drive efficient development processes.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud\-native software architectures, particularly in deploying solutions on platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure, with an interest in AI applications.
* Security\-Driven Design Practices: Understanding of security\-driven design principles and experience addressing SAST/DAST findings, especially in relation to AI data handling and model security.
* CI/CD and DevOps Proficiency: Proficiency in CI/CD and DevOps practices, including the use of Quality Gates to ensure high code quality.


**Technical Skills or Qualifications Required:**
* Extensive Programming Experience: Proven experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks, with deep expertise in at least one of the following: JavaScript, TypeScript. Familiarity with AI programming languages such as Python is a plus.
* Framework Proficiency: Strong experience with frameworks such as Nest.js, Express.js, and familiarity with AI frameworks like LangFlow or LangChain.
* Prompt Engineering Skills: Solid experience with engineering prompts to effectively interact with AI models, optimizing their performance and output for various applications.
* Testing Expertise: Proficient in Unit Testing and Integration Testing, including the ability to test AI solutions and their integrations effectively.
* Container Technologies: Experience with container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Middleware Technologies: Familiarity with any of these middleware technologies such as Kafka, Camunda, Temporal, AWS Lambda Durable function, AWS Step Function and RabbitMQ is needed.
* Design and Development Practices: Demonstrated experience in refactoring, implementing design patterns, design\-driven development, continuous integration, and application security.
* SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and practices, with experience using tools such as SharePoint, ADO, and GitHub.
* Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Experience designing and deploying applications/shared services on cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, including S3 storage.
* Stack Knowledge: Knowledge of the MEAN stack, with an interest in leveraging this technology for AI\-driven applications.
* Senior developer with 7\-11 years of experience in software development, solution design and development, plus delivering high\-quality technical projects/services.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.
